references.text: The Sabbath commandment with the death penalty for violation was given earlier in the books of Moses, where working on the Sabbath is to be punished by death.
The Sabbath commandment is repeated with a requirement of the death penalty for anyone who does work on the Sabbath day.
The same form of execution by stoning outside the camp is required for one who blasphemes God's name.
The whole congregation shall bring the guilty person outside the camp and stone him, as in the case of Sabbath-breakers.
The context of the verse telling about the man who gathered wood on the Sabbath and was held in custody until the Lord's will was made known.
The execution of the judgment that the Lord commanded, where the congregation stoned the man outside the camp.
The law concerning the stoning of idolaters at the city gate, which corresponds to execution outside the camp.
Achan was stoned by all Israel for his sin, an example of how the whole congregation carries out the death penalty by stoning.
Naboth was brought outside the city and stoned, showing the practice of execution outside the community.
Jesus suffered outside the city gate, a parallel to those who were executed outside the camp in the old covenant.
